items.title: Taiwan opens wealth-management life products to an exemption from the minimum death-benefit ratio
items.grounded_note: Taiwan's FSC amended its rules so life products sold to insurers' wealth-management clients may be exempt from the minimum ratio of death benefits to policy reserves or account value. The change expands product-design flexibility for wealth-management insurance while requiring customers to understand that these products differ from traditional protection-focused life insurance.

items.title: Taiwan broadens insurers' permitted investment in health-promotion and long-term-care businesses
items.grounded_note: The FSC said insurers may invest in a wider range of health-promotion, medical-technology, digital-health, long-term-care and age-friendly service businesses. It also relaxed the requirement that such investments be directly linked to insurance operations, increasing insurers' capital-allocation flexibility while retaining safety, liquidity and return considerations.

items.title: Mainland China consults on a comprehensive revision of the Insurance Law
items.grounded_note: The NFRA released a draft comprehensive revision of China's Insurance Law for consultation, with comments due 3 October 2026.
